title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — Original Coinsurance Charges on a Coverage Episode
content:
Under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, a booked block of benefit days 21 through 100 is billed by posting original coinsurance charges against it, one per liable party. The resident coinsurance charge is the resident's own original charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block — the share of that block billed to the resident or to the representative who pays for the resident. It falls due once that block stands booked on the episode.

What the charge does on the account: it adds one charge entry to the episode's Medicare billing history, names the booked-days entry it prices and the party billed, and raises the episode's open coinsurance balance by its amount. A payment or an adjustment later names that charge entry by its reference number.

## Posting tool: `post_coinsurance_charge_97c12690`

**Capability.** Posts one liable party's original coinsurance charge for one booked block of Part A coinsurance days on a coverage episode — to the resident (or the representative who pays for the resident), to the Medigap carrier, or to the state Medicaid crossover. The entry is dated today. The tool never records a rebill of a denied share.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it with the values below, already worked out.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `medicare_coverage_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Part A coverage episode being billed, as shown by the coverage episode lookup for the resident | Id |
| `days_entry_id` | The reference number of the booked-days entry (the block of coinsurance days) this charge prices, as shown in the episode's Medicare billing history | Id |
| `liable_party` | The party the share is billed to: `resident` = the resident's own share, billed to the resident or the representative who pays for the resident; `medigap_carrier` = the share billed to the resident's Medigap insurance company named on the coverage; `medicaid_crossover` = the share billed to the state Medicaid program for a resident with verified QMB status | One of the three values |
| `service_month` | The calendar month in which the priced days were furnished, exactly as on the booked-days entry | YYYY-MM, never empty |
| `day_count` | The number of coinsurance days the charge prices | Positive integer |
| `daily_coinsurance_rate` | The daily coinsurance rate applied to the priced days | USD per day, 2 decimal places, passed already rounded to the cent |
| `amount` | The share being billed | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, passed already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt reads: status "posted" (the charge entry now exists); the charge entry's reference number; the booked-days entry it prices; the party billed; the amount billed; today's posting date (YYYY-MM-DD); and the episode's open coinsurance balance across every liable party including this charge. The tool returns an error when the amount, the daily rate or the day count is not positive, or when the service month is not written YYYY-MM.
